---
title: "Styles"
---

Styles are defined once in a palette and referenced by ID.

## Structure

```json
{
  "styles": {
    "defs": { "<style_id>": StyleDef, ... },
    "compositions": { "<comp_id>": { "extends": "base", "overrides": {...} } },
    "conditionals": [ConditionalRule, ...]
  }
}
```

## Style Definition Fields

All fields are optional; specify only what you need. Keyword fields accept the values
listed in [Keyword values](validation.qmd#keyword-values); anything else is reported as
`UNKNOWN_VALUE`.

| Field              | Type    | Description                    |
|--------------------|---------|--------------------------------|
| `font_weight`      | string or number | `"normal"`, `"bold"`, `"bolder"`, `"lighter"`, or 1–1000 |
| `font_style`       | string  | `"normal"`, `"italic"`, `"oblique"` |
| `font_size`        | string  | CSS font-size value            |
| `font_family`      | string  | Font family name               |
| `color`            | string  | Text color                     |
| `background_color` | string  | Background color               |
| `text_align`       | string  | `"left"`, `"center"`, `"right"`, `"justify"` |
| `vertical_align`   | string  | `"top"`, `"middle"`, `"bottom"`, `"baseline"`, `"super"`, `"sub"` |
| `text_decoration`  | string  | `"none"`, `"underline"`, etc.  |
| `text_transform`   | string  | `"none"`, `"uppercase"`, etc.  |
| `white_space`      | string  | CSS white-space value          |
| `padding`          | object  | `{ top, right, bottom, left }` |
| `border`           | object  | `{ top, right, bottom, left }` |
| `indent`           | string  | Text indent value              |

### Border Side

| Field   | Type   | Description                                                    |
|---------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
| `width` | string | Border width (e.g. `"1px"`)                                    |
| `style` | string | `"solid"`, `"dashed"`, `"dotted"`, `"double"`, `"none"`        |
| `color` | string | Border color                                                   |

## Example

```json
{
  "styles": {
    "defs": {
      "header_bold": {
        "font_weight": "bold",
        "background_color": "#f0f0f0",
        "border": {
          "bottom": { "width": "2px", "style": "solid", "color": "#333333" }
        }
      },
      "numeric": {
        "font_family": "Courier New, monospace",
        "text_align": "right"
      }
    },
    "compositions": {
      "header_numeric": {
        "extends": "header_bold",
        "overrides": { "text_align": "right" }
      }
    },
    "conditionals": [{
      "id": "stripe",
      "selector": { "row_parity": "even", "scope": "tbody" },
      "style": { "background_color": "#FAFAFA" }
    }]
  }
}
```

## How Styles Combine

Every writer resolves a cell's style the same way (in `gridwell-layout`). The layers,
lowest to highest priority:

1. the column's default style (`column_spec[].style_id`), for body and summary cells
   (column labels are styled by their own row and cell styles);
2. row striping (`config.row_striping`, see [Config](config.qmd#row-striping));
3. each matching conditional style, in the order listed (later ones win);
4. the row's style (`row.style_id`);
5. the cell's style (`cell.style_id`).

A layer overrides only the properties it sets; everything else shows through from the
layers below. `padding` and `border` merge side by side, so a cell style that sets only
`border.bottom` keeps a row style's `border.top`. A border edge whose style is `none`
or `hidden` removes that edge. Values that don't parse (and keywords outside their
allowed set) are ignored, so they never reach any output.

A style id can name a definition or a composition. A composition is its `extends`
definition with `overrides` laid over it; compositions don't chain.

### Conditional selectors

| Selector field | Values | Matches |
|---|---|---|
| `scope` | `tbody` (`body`) | data rows of every group (not summary rows) |
| | `thead` (`head`) | column-label rows |
| | `table` (`all`), or absent | every row |
| `row_parity` | `odd`, `even` | rows numbered from 1, as in CSS `:nth-child(odd)`: data rows count across all groups, head rows within the head, summary rows within their group |
| | absent | every row in scope |

Unknown values match nothing (and are reported as `UNKNOWN_VALUE`).

## Color Values

- Named: all 148 CSS named colors (`red`, `steelblue`, `rebeccapurple`, …)
- Hex: `#RGB`, `#RGBA`, `#RRGGBB`, `#RRGGBBAA`
- Functional: `rgb()`/`rgba()` and `hsl()`/`hsla()`, in comma syntax
  (`rgb(255, 0, 0)`) or space syntax with optional alpha (`rgb(255 0 0 / 50%)`)
- Keyword: `transparent`

Anything else fails validation with `INVALID_COLOR`; see
[Validation](validation.qmd#colours) for details and for the length forms each field
accepts.
